text:
sam.ops: Heads-up — 10 H100s landed in FRA pool, 2 failing POST at depot. AWBs 9988776655 & 9988776656. This reduces eu-dedicated-2 capacity for next deploy. Need RMA + replacement routing.
vendor_marta: Sorry — opening RMA now. Depot sent photos and boot logs. We can hot-swap 2 units from our US reserve, ETA ~72h incl customs.
rita-procure: Air is fine if uplift < $5k/unit. Otherwise prefer NL crossdock re-route.
alex-sre: If we lose 2 GPUs we'll hit queuing on batch jobs; can we get temporary overflow to eu-edge or shift non-critical jobs to us-east?
vendor_marta: Forwarder flagged missing commercial invoice on 9988776655. They can reissue but need receiver sign-off (importer declaration). Reissue + air surcharge = $4.8k/unit.
sam.ops: @vendor_marta drop the CI & depot photos into the RMA ticket. Also share replacement serials ASAP so infra can pre-stage.
lee-logs: Current inventory tag: eu-dedicated-2. If replacements come from US reserve, we'll tag eu-temp-2 and route through AMS crossdock for customs clearance. Pre-stage PMEM and burn-in nodes.
rita-procure: We approve emergency air up to $4.5k/unit without extra sign-off. If surcharge > $4.5k, route via crossdock. Vendor, will you absorb any part?
vendor_marta: We can cover $2k/unit of surcharge. Propose split remainder 50/50.
alex-sre: Two operational asks: 1) if replacement is RMA refurb, require 6h burn-in; 2) run canary job on attach, rollback if perf regression >12%.
logistics_bot: Notice: eu-dedicated-2 expected -2 GPUs from 2023-11-05T03:00Z until replacement attach.
vendor_marta: RMA-2023-0499 created: https://rma.vendor/2023/0499 — docs uploaded, reissue requested. Provisional ETA 60h pending importer declaration.
sam.ops: Who signs importer declaration? If vendor needs our legal team, loop them in now.
rita-procure: We can sign but need vendor to confirm they cover customs fines/penalties if paperwork rejected.
vendor_marta: We'll accept liability for paperwork rejections on our side. Send form template and we'll sign.
lee-logs: When serials available please share in this exact format so infra automation can consume:
```nreplace_serials: [H100-US90001, H100-US90002]nawbs: [9988776655-reissue]nroute: ams-crossdock -> eu-dedicated-2n```
sam.ops: Also confirm whether replacements are new or refurbished. If refurbished, label pending-burnin.
vendor_marta: Replacements are new pull from reserve. Will attach S/Ns within 4 hours and confirm shipping docs.
alex-sre: I'll prepare a short traffic-shift playbook to move noncritical workloads temporarily. Share here once S/Ns posted.
rita-procure: Noted — I'll greenlight up to $4.5k/unit. Finance on standby if vendor asks for more.
logistics_bot: RMA ticket updated: RMA-2023-0499 status "awaiting importer declaration".
sam.ops: Ok team — keep updates here. Ping me directly if ETA slips past 48h or paperwork stalls. :thumbsup:
